title: Apps and sites: who made or owns them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?ownerLabel ?born WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?o) AS ?owner) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(STR(?bT), "|", STR(?bP)); separator=";") AS ?born) WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q620615 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q202833 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q35127 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q17155 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q1329336 } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks ; wdt:P178|wdt:P127 ?o . FILTER(?sitelinks > 25) ?item p:P571 ?st . ?st a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P571 [ wikibase:timeValue ?bT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?bP ] . } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?o)=1) ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

owner.match: Match each app or site to the company behind it.
owner.reverse: Which app or site is made or owned by {value}?

launched.sort: from the earliest launched to the most recent
launched.era: Drop each app or site into the decade it launched.

rows.label: Facebook
rows.description: American online social media and social networking service
rows.hook: connects friends through profiles, walls and a famous thumbs-up button

rows.label: Gmail
rows.hook: offers free webmail with huge storage and a search-based inbox

rows.label: GitHub
rows.description: hosting service for software projects using Git
rows.hook: lets programmers store, share and collaborate on source code projects

rows.label: Telegram
rows.hook: is a chat app known for large channels, bots and secret chats

rows.label: Wayback Machine
rows.description: digital archive founded by the Internet Archive
rows.hook: lets you view saved snapshots of old web pages

rows.label: Pinterest
rows.description: American photo sharing and publishing website
rows.hook: lets users save images to themed boards for recipes, crafts and decor

rows.label: Spotify
rows.hook: streams music and podcasts on a free ad-supported or paid plan

rows.label: Yahoo
rows.hook: is an early web portal known for its email, news and a famous yodel

rows.label: Snapchat
rows.hook: sends photos and videos that disappear after being viewed

rows.label: Twitch
rows.hook: lets gamers broadcast live and chat with fans as they play

rows.label: IMDb
rows.description: online database of information related to films, television series, and video games
rows.hook: lists casts, ratings and trivia for movies and TV shows

rows.label: DeviantArt
rows.hook: hosts a community gallery of fan drawings and digital illustrations

rows.label: App Store
rows.description: digital app distribution platform for iOS/iPadOS
rows.hook: lets iPhone owners browse and download programs for their devices

rows.label: Messenger
rows.description: instant messaging app developed by Meta Platforms
rows.hook: lets Facebook users chat, send stickers and make video calls

rows.label: Tumblr
rows.description: microblogging platform and social networking website

rows.label: Signal
rows.hook: is a secure chat app favored for end-to-end encryption and privacy

rows.label: Tinder
rows.hook: matches people by swiping right or left on profile photos

rows.label: Threads

rows.label: Fandom
rows.hook: hosts fan-built wikis for movies, games and TV shows

rows.label: TED
rows.hook: hosts short inspirational talks under the slogan ideas worth spreading

rows.label: Viber
rows.description: cross-platform instant messaging voice-over-Internet Protocol application for smartphones
rows.hook: is a chat app offering free calls and stickers, popular in Eastern Europe
